definitions.cash: Gross reported cash contributions, including reviewed City matching payments; before refunds. Loans and noncash support are separate.
definitions.nonmatching: Cash contributions other than reviewed City matching transaction IDs. Includes unidentified, organizational and self/family receipts; not exclusively individual money.
definitions.sources: Exclusive source categories: reviewed matching first, disclosure/unknown next, then reported book type.
definitions.geography: Reported counterparty city/state on nonmatching cash receipts; aggregate categories and unrecognized states stay unknown. Portland postal locality is not a city-boundary or district-residency test.
definitions.donors: Conservative record groups, not verified unique people. Aggregate labels are excluded. Repeat means different reported dates to this committee.
definitions.window: January 1, 2025–September 27, 2026; not a full election cycle. November–December 2024 missing; recent activity provisional.
